name: Cherokee
schedule: First Tuesday when scheduled, 90 North Street, Canton
note: The county posts only sale dates, not parcel lists. Excess funds are handled by Weissman Law.

auction.venue: Cherokee County Courthouse (steps of the Superior Court building)
auction.time: First Tuesday of the month after four weeks of advertising, 10:00 am; bidder signup 9:30 am
auction.registration: Bidder signup is at 9:30 am on sale day at the courthouse. The purchaser must show identification such as a driver's license and is issued a property purchase form.
auction.payment: Cash or certified funds (cashier's or certified check). Pay at the Tax Commissioner's office, 2780 Marietta Hwy, Canton, by 1:00 pm the day of sale.
vital: Caveat emptor: the county does not guarantee title.
The buyer has no use of the property and no right to rents for at least one year.
The owner may redeem within 12 months by paying the bid plus a 20% premium (10% for each additional year).
The tax deed is executed and recorded about 4 to 6 weeks after the sale.
Bids are binding (O.C.G.A. 9-13-170); mobile homes do not convey with the property.
Sale properties are advertised in the Thursday Cherokee Tribune for four weeks.
auction.confirmed: Tax sales page still shows the April 7, 2026 sale
